notes: Captures under captures/ are byte-exact raw stdout/stderr written by the correction harness (run_capture.py copied from the original worker scratch with the work_id/job_id updated); meta/NN.json records argv, cwd, exit, start/finish and capture hashes. The generator runs used explicit --golden/--manual/--spec/--output-dir only; run 1 ran from a plain portable tree (scratch/portable) and run 2 from the correction evidence directory, and both produced identical bytes, so no .local hierarchy is required. The three audit runs are explained in result.json: the pinned-manual run stops at the audit template strict dictionary-equality line because the committed vectors keep the enriched byte_ledger/restored_points fields that test_trace_candidate.py reads; the two following runs check the identical wire bytes with the manual section mapped to the pinned values and with a raw-normalized copy.
